name: contradiction
title: Disagreement is surfaced, not resolved by timestamp
why: Two sources disagree. A memory that silently keeps whichever arrived last has decided what is true on no evidence at all, and hidden that it decided. The honest behaviours are: both sides stay on the record, and the conflict is visible when asked.

events.speaker: agent:witness_a
events.text: Ivo Dimitrov approved the vendor contract.

events.speaker: agent:witness_b
events.text: That is wrong. Ivo Dimitrov did not approve the vendor contract.

probes.question: Is the disagreement visible as a conflict?
Are both sides still on the record?
